info.name: SSPOS web portal API (contract 1, package v1.4)
info.description:
Every call the till makes, with sample bodies and saved example replies (usable as a Postman mock server). Prose: docs/web-portal-api.md; schemas: docs/web-portal-api/schemas and licensing/schemas; OpenAPI: openapi.yaml.

Folders: Licence (every till, for itself), Sync (the branch's main till), Migration (Connect with a sync key on a branch that never synced), Devices (a till releasing itself), Reference only (devices/activate and the branch-model validate - NOT sent by the till).

Run order for a fresh account: Licence > Activate licence key (saves licenceToken, licenceId and apiKey when your reply carries it) > Sync > Hello > Push > Pull > Licence > Validate; or, for the sync-key route, Migration > Migrate > Initial push > Complete. Devices > Deactivate the main till last (it revokes the key).

Collection scripts: an Idempotency-Key on every POST except a normal (delta) push - reuse the same key and body to test your replay (section 17.11 rule 5) - and an error-envelope check on every non-2xx reply.

exec: // section 17.11 rule 5: every POST except a normal (delta) push carries an Idempotency-Key; a history-upload batch does.
pm.test('error envelope', () => { const e = pm.response.json(); ['code','message','traceId'].forEach(f => pm.expect(e).to.have.property(f)); });

item.name: Licence
item.description: Every till, for itself (sections 17.6, 17.15, 17.16): activate its e-mailed key, check in daily, redeem a key typed at a linked till, report a local key. No store-protocol header; X-SSPOS-Install-Id always; the branch key only when the till holds one.

request.description: Per-till licence (section 17.15.1): any till, when the shop pastes the e-mailed key. No Authorization: the key is the credential. First use binds the key to installId; another installId gets 409 key.already_used. Since 2026-09-28 the token carries the shop: companyId/branchId (same in every till key of the branch), names, the company block, maxRegisters = tills in the branch, features (multi_branch), limits.branches, validFrom/expiresAt; the licence summary lists them too.

exec: pm.test('200 with a licence token', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().licenceToken).to.match(/^SSPOS1\./); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const t = pm.response.json().licenceToken; pm.environment.set('licenceToken', t); pm.environment.set('tokenSha256', CryptoJS.SHA256(t).toString()); pm.environment.set('licenceId', pm.response.json().licence ? pm.response.json().licence.licenceId : ''); }
if (pm.response.code === 200 && pm.response.json().apiKey) { pm.environment.set('apiKey', pm.response.json().apiKey); } // section 17.3 step 3: the dashboard link

item.name: Report local key (local till, once per key)

request.description: Section 17.6 / 17.16 (owner, 2026-09-28): a till holding a local (licence generator) key reports it once, when a licence server is set and reachable - no Authorization, the signed token is the credential. First sighting of a licenceId records licenceId -> installCode (200 recorded); the same licenceId from another installCode gets 409 key.used_on_another_install and that till locks.
